I was wondering why I hadn't seen the memory-identical test fail before, but I realized it came in with the rebase (2673d42ba73b6232cd21b89e9148d2e5d6c9a356 / https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/142696), nice 😄 

The current conversions are not memory-identical due to us doing the "hack" of redefining the `Convert_` function to make it get picked up. So if https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/142345 gets solved we can make the conversions memory-identical. There is a copy-only flag for conversion-gen, but I felt that could be a dangerous override if the types would diverge silently later.

Also unified the validation of what types are supported for both ACR `request.decision.type` and `response.decision.type`; now an unknown type yields just one error not two, as suggested above.
